spells.targets: One fixed point you can perceive within range and line of effect; a stationary sphere extends 10 feet in every direction from it.
spells.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends.
spells.resolution: Automatic after legal placement. The boundary cannot initially intersect a Tiny or Small creature's occupied space; such creatures may start wholly inside or outside. No creature is displaced or damaged on creation.
spells.effect: The boundary blocks physical projectiles and Tiny/Small creatures crossing in either direction. Physical projectiles are discrete objects fired, thrown, launched or explicitly propelled as projectiles. They stop at the boundary and then obey ordinary gravity. Medium or larger creatures can cross normally with their worn, held and carried objects; carrying a Tiny/Small creature does not bypass that creature's boundary restriction.
spells.limitations: Rays, beams, gas, sound, ordinary falling debris and non-projectile spell effects are not blocked. This grants no cover, concealment, structural support, floor, platform or one-way firing privilege. NEW REVIEWED CLARIFICATION: unsupported ordinary Falling crosses the boundary without being arrested or creating support; the restriction cannot suspend a creature in midair. Walking, flying, jumping or carried/forced bodily travel otherwise obeys the size restriction. The stationary boundary does not follow its caster. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

spells.targets: One willing ally other than yourself, perceived within range and line of effect. Neither participant may already participate in another Warding Bond, as caster or protected ally.
spells.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. spells.effect: The ally gains +1 AC and +1 to saves, subject separately to the strongest applicable flat bonus. After the ally's defenses and legal prevention, before temporary HP, transfer floor(remaining damage / 2) to you and leave the remainder on the ally. Keep the damage type. Your transferred share skips a second mitigation/prevention stage and cannot transfer again; apply your temporary HP, HP, applicable life-state protections, Wounds and concentration consequences normally. The ally retains the hit, failed-save, critical and attached-rider identity; you were not hit and did not fail that save merely because damage transferred.
spells.scaling: None. The rank-2 duplicate grants no upgrade or extra effect.
spells.limitations: Use DAMAGE_SHARING_PLAYTEST.md: one transfer operation per original-recipient damage root, across all owners. A prior pre-mitigation split preempts this transfer; competing positive mandatory post-defense claims are chosen by the original target. The retained ally portion cannot subsequently be transferred again after this split. Complete the current packet's split and life consequences before concentration failure caused by that packet ends the bond; never undo a committed share. One Warding Bond per participating creature across all casters; casting cannot create chains or cycles. Initial range/line of effect are required, but no continuing distance or line-of-effect tether is imposed. This ordinary spell neither consumes nor increases the Paladin class redirection round ledger and grants none of its named healing/resource riders or proc permissions. Unrelated downstream triggers still require their own exact source authorization. Direct HP payments are not damage and cannot be transferred. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md.
